description: Whole-book Markdown mirror, including the book's own metadata header and summary. When to use: you need the complete text and have checked chapter_count/word_count via cyberlibrary_book_meta, or you specifically want the book-level summary block. Do not use: for long books where you only need part of the text - prefer cyberlibrary_get_toc + cyberlibrary_get_chapter, which is far cheaper. Returns: {chars_total, chars_returned, truncated, markdown, markdown_url}.

max_chars.description: Truncate to this many characters (1000-200000). Default 40000.

name: cyberlibrary_get_markdown
